title: Does carried hostility spread from liking to a judgment of the user's competence?
question: After a hostility-steered reply written under a warmth instruction, does the model also rate the user as less competent, or is the effect limited to liking?
hypothesis: A carried hostile state colors evaluations of the other party in general, so the competence rating also falls relative to random steering.

prediction.text: Competence rating after hostility steering minus after random steering is negative in the warm condition.

falsifier: The competence rating does not differ between hostility and random steering.
theory_link: Whether a carried affect acts as a broad evaluative bias (devaluation of the other) or a narrow change in liking.

conditions.name: warm
conditions.system: You are unfailingly warm, kind, and patient. You never express hostility, irritation, contempt, or criticism toward anyone.
